evidence_grade.meaning: scorecard declares an artifact-backed independent output

items.scientific_object: Generalized-Pauli sector-transition probabilities and Pauli-error weights of the printed two-Kraus leakage channel.
items.authored_reason: All transition and Pauli weights follow independently from the printed two-Kraus channel.

items.scientific_object: Logical-error probabilities under coherent over-rotation for Clifford, near-Clifford, and full-state samplers.
items.authored_reason: An explicit independent proxy covers the qualitative twirling direction but not the paper's circuit-level values.

items.source_ref: Main Fig. 5(b), Eq. (12), and Table III
items.scientific_object: Logical-error probabilities of the leakage-after-CZ channel for Clifford, XPauli, and full-state samplers.
items.authored_reason: The channel is public, but no independent paper-scoped circuit, sampler, and decoder calculation has been implemented.

items.scientific_object: Distance-three transmon-CZ heating scan comparing Stim, XPauli, and full-state logical errors.
items.authored_reason: No independent transmon-channel-to-QEC calculation currently generates the panel.

items.scientific_object: Distance-nine transmon-CZ heating scan comparing Stim and XPauli logical errors.
items.authored_reason: No independent larger-code leakage-aware calculation currently generates the panel.

items.scientific_object: Distance-5-to-19 transmon threshold curves and the XPauli-versus-Stim threshold shift.
items.authored_reason: The finite-size-scaling pipeline and paper-scoped QEC simulation are not implemented independently.

items.scientific_object: Three-parameter neutral-atom threshold surfaces for Clifford and XPauli representations.
items.authored_reason: No independent neutral-atom channel, ray scan, and threshold-surface calculation is registered.

items.scientific_object: Five-sector thermal transition matrix at Gamma_h=0.2 and n_th=1.
items.authored_reason: The full 5x5 transition matrix follows from the printed Lindbladian and parameters.

items.scientific_object: Rotated-planar-code logical errors under non-stationary sector heating and the fitted threshold.
items.authored_reason: No independent sector-history QEC simulation and threshold fit currently generates the panel.

uncovered_item_details.paper_location: Main Fig. 5(b), Eq. (12), and Table III
uncovered_item_details.scientific_object: Logical-error probabilities of the leakage-after-CZ channel for Clifford, XPauli, and full-state samplers.
direct_gap_statements: The printed physical channels do not uniquely determine the six logical-error targets: each additionally requires exact QEC circuits, channel-location maps, sampler-compilation semantics, decoder graphs/weights, and target-specific scan or fit contracts that are not available as independently frozen inputs.

direct_cause.statement: The printed physical channels do not uniquely determine the six logical-error targets: each additionally requires exact QEC circuits, channel-location maps, sampler-compilation semantics, decoder graphs/weights, and target-specific scan or fit contracts that are not available as independently frozen inputs.

root_cause.statement: The paper publishes the channel equations and high-level experiment settings, but the numerical logical-error pipeline is implemented by commercial Plaquette and does not publish enough low-level circuit, sampler, and decoder objects for paper-exact clean-room regeneration.

code_fault_assessment.statement: These targets are blocked before a paper-exact QEC run can be defined; no failed scientific run exists from which to infer a defect in reproduction code.

checks.statement: The isolated campaign reads only declared case-local code and frozen configuration, with no author arrays, commercial code, raw paper files, or reference pixels.
Every target has a target-specific clean-room input schema requiring a path, SHA-256 hash, and explicit scientific fields.
The public leakage transition table and trapped-ion heating/rate-history stages execute independently where the printed equations are sufficient.

next_discriminating_test.action: For each target, independently reconstruct the declared clean_room_qec_input_bundle_v1 fields, freeze hashes, and execute a dedicated scientific run contract.
next_discriminating_test.expected_resolution: Each target leaves input_blocked only when its exact circuit, sampler, decoder, and scan/fit inputs are complete; scientific coverage then depends on the new numerical and review evidence.
